structured_output.what_is_happening: Effective FOMO ($fomo/acc) is a pump.fun coin that riffs on e/acc ("effective accelerationism"). It launched about 12 minutes before detection (12:58:57 UTC) and GMGN shows it already migrated to PumpSwap. It has done about $732k of volume on an $87k market cap: 27x turnover, 986 unique buyers against 734 sellers, and +26% in the last 5 minutes. Price is about 27% below its ATH of $0.000119. Wallet data is mixed. GMGN flags 213 bundler wallets and 329 fresh wallets (28%), but the top 10 hold only 13.75% (RugCheck count, excluding the AMM), the dev holds 0.4%, and LP is burned. The creator is on its first token and was funded from KuCoin. The project site fomoacc.site is a generic neon landing page, and I found no web-indexed X discussion or event trigger.

narrative.description: A pun on e/acc, the tech-accelerationism meme ('fomo/acc'). The name mocks degen FOMO in e/acc language. No current e/acc news event or tweet from an influencer that would trigger it was found. Similar 'e/fomo' / 'Effective Fomo' coins appeared about 2.5 hours earlier, which hints at a small recurring meme, possibly from an untraced tweet.
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely pump.fun trenches momentum: a fast bond plus heavy early volume and a catchy crypto-native joke. No outside catalyst was verified.

token_connection.why_this_token: Of all the same-name tokens, this one has all the real liquidity and volume. The site and socials (fomoaccdev, @EffectiveFOMO) link to the pump.fun launch.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Four same-name or ticker tokens. Two are 'e/fomo' coins created about 2.5 hours earlier (a bags token and a pump token), both dead. A bags FOMO/ACC copy launched about 7 minutes after this one with $0 liquidity, and a pump fomo/acc copy launched seconds later is worth about $3k. None has any traction.

authenticity.evidence: Buyers look broad: 986 unique buyers and 1,067 holders. Concentration is low (top 10 at 13.75%, dev 0.4%) and there are no paid DexScreener boosts. But 213 bundler wallets and 28% fresh wallets point to coordinated launch activity. The top bundler trader share is 13.6%. There are 4 smart wallets and 1 renowned (KOL) wallet.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X at all (the account page returned 402). The Telegram content is invisible. I can't tell whether call channels are driving this.

structural_risks: Liquidity is only $26.7k against $377k traded in 5 minutes, so price swings will be large
Already 27% below ATH just 12 minutes after launch
GeckoTerminal's holder distribution conflicts with RugCheck's (it shows top 10 at 91%, probably counting pool accounts)

structured_output.counterargument: A coin that bonded almost instantly and did $700k+ of volume in 12 minutes with nearly 1,000 unique buyers is in the pool that produces runners. Holders are spread out, LP is burned, and the dev holds almost nothing, so a structural rug is unlikely. From an $87k cap, a 2x to $175k is small for a hot migration. On the other side, the bundlers and the missing catalyst suggest this is a launch pump that fades after the first wave.

source_coverage.notes: Web searches for the contract, name and ticker found nothing relevant. The X profile fetch returned 402. The site fomoacc.site is a generic meme landing page. I ran out of time before searching Reddit, Telegram and Discord.

structured_output.thesis: A fresh, hot pump.fun migration with strong turnover and a reasonably clean distribution (low top-10 share, burned LP, clean dev). The main drags are heavy bundler and fresh-wallet activity and no verified external narrative. It is the canonical token for its name. It has a better-than-average shot for this pool, but it is already off its ATH and a first-wave fade is the base case.
